name: weighted lying neck extension
description: Lying face down, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.
